title: Valley Family Health Care notifies patients of breach of SSNs and medical data
date_note: Notices dated and filed from November 18 (per ClaimDepot); the network disruption began around March 2026 (the provider says March 13, the California AG listing says March 7).
place: Idaho and Oregon, United States (headquarters city not stated)
summary: Valley Family Health Care, a community health center serving Idaho and Oregon, says an unauthorized actor accessed and acquired certain files after a network disruption in March 2026. Its notice lists names with Social Security or driver's licence numbers, dates of birth, financial, medical and health insurance information, though not every element was affected for everyone. The number of people affected is not stated. It reports no evidence of misuse.
plain: A health center in Idaho and Oregon says someone took files holding patients' names, Social Security numbers and medical details. It has begun sending letters.
exec: Health-data breach at a community health center; identity-theft risk for patients and state breach-notification exposure.
action: If you are a Valley Family Health Care patient, watch for its letter, take the offered identity protection (enrol by Feb. 18, 2027 per ClaimDepot), review insurance statements and consider a credit freeze.
impact: Number of people affected not stated in the notice.

sources.name: Valley Family Health Care notice of data breach

validation.note: The provider's own notice and the California Attorney General listing, read directly; ClaimDepot gives the Nov. 18 notice date and enrolment deadline. Breach date differs between the notice (March 13) and the AG listing (March 7); no affected count in either.
